source_data.desc: This spell helps you locate a specific kind of beast or plant, which you can either name or describe. You learn the direction and distance to the closest creature or plant of that kind within 1 mile, if any are present.
source_data.higher_level: If you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level, the range of the spell increases to 5 miles. If you use a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the range increases by 5 additional miles for each slot level above 2nd.
source_data.name: Find in Nature
